worksheet.title: Traffic Plan Worksheet
worksheet.description: Plan your free traffic strategy. Where will you show up, how often, and what will you do first?

fields.label: Free channels chosen
fields.helpText: Which specific channels will you use? (e.g. Reddit r/dogs, Facebook group 'First-time dog owners UK', Instagram). Include the platform and the specific community or account.

fields.label: Community participation plan
fields.helpText: For each community: how will you become a genuine member before mentioning your product? What will you contribute?

fields.label: Posting frequency
fields.helpText: How many times per week will you post on social media? Be realistic based on your time budget from Chapter 4.

fields.label: First week actions
fields.helpText: Specifically: what will you do this week? Join which communities, post on which platforms, reach out to which people in your network?
